title: Silicon carbide capacity (wafers & fabs)
scope: Substrate / boule / wafer / epi / captive fab throughput for SiC power. Not device design-wins (see field-sic Infineon/STM). Not burn-in equipment (see sic-burn-in.html AEHR/Cohu).
framing: Research shortlist only. No gold/rainbow/stance until Performance tracker scores. Not investment advice.

companies.name: Wolfspeed
companies.role: Vertical SiC materials + Mohawk Valley 200mm fab / JP materials center — capacity pure-play.
companies.whyCapacityNotDevice: Story is wafer/fab throughput and materials scale, not SST design-wins.
companies.caveats: Chapter 11 emergence Sep 2025; fresh-start accounting; Renesas equity; dilution/covenant overhang.

companies.name: Coherent
companies.role: Merchant SiC substrates and epitaxial wafers (incl. 200mm epi).
companies.whyCapacityNotDevice: Materials/epi supplier; does not compete as a power-device brand on the device field.
companies.caveats: Lasers/networking dilute SiC purity; EV wafer demand cyclical.

companies.name: onsemi
companies.role: Captive end-to-end SiC (boule → epi → fab), e.g. Hudson NH; Czech 200mm plans.
companies.whyCapacityNotDevice: Investment angle is captive capacity assurance; finished devices are secondary for this field.
companies.caveats: Also sells devices; Czech expansion timing/incentive uncertainty.

companies.name: Resonac
companies.role: Independent SiC epitaxial-wafer specialist — merchant epi capacity.
companies.whyCapacityNotDevice: Epi/materials only; no MOSFET design-win narrative on this hub.
companies.caveats: Chemicals conglomerate mix; ADR liquidity; China substrate competition.

companies.name: ROHM
companies.role: SiCrystal substrates + captive SiC device fabs — vertical capacity.
companies.whyCapacityNotDevice: Listed for substrate/fab footprint; not scored on Infineon/STM device field.
companies.caveats: EV SiC demand softness; Japan ADR liquidity; conglomerate mix.

companies.name: DISCO
companies.whyCapacityNotDevice: Equipment for wafer throughput, not devices and not burn-in (AEHR/Cohu).
companies.caveats: Broad semi-equipment cycle; SiC is a slice of revenue.

crossLinksOnly.name: Infineon
crossLinksOnly.note: Captive SiC fab capacity exists; scored under devices for design wins.

crossLinksOnly.name: STMicroelectronics
crossLinksOnly.note: Catania/Singapore/Chongqing SiC hubs; scored under devices.
